entries.title: Psalms 17:1
segments: ¶<<A Prayer of David.>> Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, [that goeth] not out of feigned lips. {the right: Heb. justice} {not...: Heb. without lips of deceit}

words.text: . {the right: Heb. justice} {not...: Heb. without lips of deceit}

entries.title: Psalms 17:2
segments: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.

entries.title: Psalms 17:3
segments: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited [me] in the night; thou hast tried me, [and] shalt find nothing; I am purposed [that] my mouth shall not transgress.

entries.title: Psalms 17:4
segments: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept [me from] the paths of the destroyer.

entries.title: Psalms 17:5
segments: Hold up my goings in thy paths, [that] my footsteps slip not. {slip...: Heb. be not moved}

entries.title: Psalms 17:6
segments: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, [and hear] my speech.

words.text: upon thee, for thou wilt hear

entries.title: Psalms 17:7
segments: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust [in thee] from those that rise up [against them]. {by thy...: or, them which trust in thee from those that rise up against thy right hand}

[against them]. {by thy...: or, them which trust in thee from those that rise up against thy right hand}

entries.title: Psalms 17:8
segments: ¶Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

entries.title: Psalms 17:9
segments: From the wicked that oppress me, [from] my deadly enemies, [who] compass me about. {oppress: Heb. waste} {my...: Heb. my enemies against the soul}

words.text: . {oppress: Heb. waste} {my...: Heb. my enemies against the soul}

entries.title: Psalms 17:10
segments: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

entries.title: Psalms 17:11
segments: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 17:12

entries.title: Psalms 17:13
segments: Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, [which is] thy sword: {disappoint...: Heb. prevent his face} {which is: or, by}

segments: From men [which are] thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, [which have] their portion in [this] life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid [treasure]: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their [substance] to their babes. {which are: or, by} {they...: or, their children are full}

entries.title: Psalms 17:15
segments: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
